pin_diff.note: Pin 4 differs (NC/NC vs BYP/BYPASS): safe only if PCB leaves Pin 4 floating or decoupled via 10 nF to GND; if PCB ties NC pin directly to GND/VIN, trace cut is mandatory.

parameter_matrix.note: Wider operating Vin window supports broader rail & battery chemistry headroom.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_a_value: Ceramic OK · >=1 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: HIGH PIN 4 (NC vs BYPASS/NR) CHECK: One device uses Pin 4 as an internal bandgap bypass/noise-reduction node while the other is NC. Verify Pin 4 is NOT tied to GND or VIN on the existing PCB before swapping; add a 10 nF bypass cap if low noise is required.

CRITICAL CAPACITOR ESR OSCILLATION RISK: AP2112K-3.3TRG1 is stable with low-ESR ceramic MLCCs (>= 1 µF, p.2), whereas AP2210K-3.3TRG1 is NOT ceramic-cap stable (ESR window: 0.025–15 Ω (p.22)). Using an ultra-low-ESR MLCC on AP2210K-3.3TRG1 can trigger control-loop oscillation.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: AP2112K-3.3TRG1 is rated to only 6 V rec. (6.5 V abs max, p.3) vs AP2210K-3.3TRG1 at 13.2 V rec. (15 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: AP2210K-3.3TRG1 supplies up to 300 mA (p.1) compared to AP2112K-3.3TRG1 at 600 mA (p.8); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
engineering_verdict: AP2112K-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-5) and AP2210K-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required replacements: while the footprint is physically compatible, engineering review and passive/circuit adjustments are mandatory due to Pin 4 NC vs BYPASS difference; ceramic output capacitor ESR stability difference; Vin,max rating drops >20%. Key datasheet deltas: Iq is 55 µA (p.8) vs 100 µA (p.11), max output current is 600 mA (p.8) vs 300 mA (p.1), recommended Vin,max is 6 V (p.3) vs 13.2 V (p.4), typical dropout is 250 mV (p.8) vs 250 mV (p.11), and ceramic capacitor stability is supported vs ESR-constrained. Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.1), thermal margin (θJA 184 vs 200 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
